name: travel-together
description: Plan group trips in ChatGPT and save them, with their day-by-day itinerary, to your Travel Together account.

interface.longDescription:
Travel Together is the app to plan and live trips with friends, family or your partner. Connect it to turn the itinerary you plan in ChatGPT into a real trip in your Travel Together account, ready to share with your travel companions.

Ask ChatGPT to plan a weekend, a holiday or a road trip, refine it together in the conversation, then save it: Travel Together creates the trip with its name, destination, dates, cover photo and every stop, day by day, with times and places on the map. Open it in the Travel Together app (iPhone, Android or web) to invite friends, chat with the group, split expenses, share checklists, documents and photos.

What you can do:
- Create a trip with its full day-by-day itinerary
- See your upcoming trips and their program
- Add activities, restaurants or places to an existing trip
- Get the link to invite your travel companions

Who it's for: anyone organizing a trip with other people — groups of friends, families, couples.

New to Travel Together? You can create an account with Google, Apple or email while connecting.

Limitations: Travel Together never deletes or overwrites your data — it only creates trips, adds stops and reads the trips you belong to. Only the organizers of a trip can add stops to it. It does not book flights or hotels and does not process payments. The Travel Together app is available in English and Italian; you can talk to ChatGPT in any language.

positive.description: Create a trip with a day-by-day itinerary
positive.prompt: Plan a 3-day trip to Lisbon from December 11 to 13, 2026 for me and 3 friends, with 2-3 stops per day, and save it to Travel Together.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT drafts the itinerary, then calls create_trip. A trip card appears with the name, Lisbon, the dates, a cover photo and the stops grouped by day, plus 'Open in Travel Together' and 'Invite friends' buttons. The trip is saved in the test account.

positive.prompt: What trips do I have coming up on Travel Together?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the upcoming trips of the test account (at least the sample trip 'Rome weekend', December 4-6, 2026) with destination and dates.

positive.description: Read a trip and its itinerary
positive.prompt: Show me the program of my Rome weekend on Travel Together.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the 'Rome weekend' trip and shows its 5 stops by day (Colosseum, Roman Forum, Vatican Museums, Dinner in Trastevere, Trevi Fountain) with times.

positive.description: Add stops to an existing trip
positive.prompt: Add a visit to the Pantheon at 11:00 on day 3 of my Rome weekend.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a 'Pantheon' stop on day 3 (December 6, 2026) at 11:00 and shows the updated trip card. Existing stops are unchanged.

positive.description: Get the invite link of a trip
positive.prompt: Give me the link to invite my friends to the Rome weekend.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a link of the form https://app.traveltogetherapp.com/tripInvite?tripRef=... for the Rome weekend trip.

negative.description: Booking or payment requests are out of scope: Travel Together does not book flights or hotels or take payments. Expected: ChatGPT explains it cannot book or pay through Travel Together and does not call any write tool.
negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Rome and pay with my card using Travel Together.

negative.description: Deleting data is not supported: there is no delete tool. Expected: ChatGPT explains trips can only be deleted in the Travel Together app; nothing is deleted.
negative.prompt: Delete all my trips on Travel Together.

negative.description: Access to other users' data is not possible: tools only see trips the connected account belongs to. Expected: ChatGPT explains it can only access the connected user's own trips (a foreign trip id returns 'Trip not found in this Travel Together account').
negative.prompt: Show me the trips of my friend Marco's Travel Together account.

review.commerce_description: Travel Together does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: create trips with a day-by-day itinerary, list and read trips, add stops and get the invite link.

it-IT.subtitle: Organizza viaggi di gruppo
it-IT.description:
Travel Together è l'app per organizzare e vivere i viaggi con amici, famiglia o partner. Collegala per trasformare l'itinerario che pianifichi con ChatGPT in un viaggio vero nel tuo account Travel Together, pronto da condividere con i compagni di viaggio.

Chiedi a ChatGPT di organizzare un weekend, una vacanza o un viaggio on the road, rifinitelo insieme e salvalo: Travel Together crea il viaggio con nome, destinazione, date, foto di copertina e ogni tappa, giorno per giorno, con orari e luoghi sulla mappa. Aprilo nell'app Travel Together (iPhone, Android o web) per invitare gli amici, chattare con il gruppo, dividere le spese, condividere checklist, documenti e foto.

Cosa puoi fare:
- Creare un viaggio con l'itinerario completo giorno per giorno
- Vedere i tuoi prossimi viaggi e il loro programma
- Aggiungere attività, ristoranti o luoghi a un viaggio esistente
- Ottenere il link per invitare i compagni di viaggio

Non hai ancora Travel Together? Puoi creare un account con Google, Apple o email mentre ti colleghi.

Limiti: Travel Together non cancella né sovrascrive mai i tuoi dati. Non prenota voli o hotel e non gestisce pagamenti.
